IndexPoints.name: Index Points
IndexPoints.definition: Number of points above the index used to calculate a price.

IndexFixingDate.name: Index Fixing Date
IndexFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which an index rate will be determined .

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the index by a name for instance LIBOR.

ReferenceSource.name: Reference Source
ReferenceSource.definition: Identifies the reference source. The source can be the fixing agent or a system.

IndexRateCurrency.name: Index Rate Currency
IndexRateCurrency.definition: Specifies the currency of the reference rate for fixed income instruments where the price of the instrument is indexed to the price of an underlying benchmark.

IndexRateFrequency.name: Index Rate Frequency
IndexRateFrequency.definition: Frequency at which the index changes.

IndexFactor.name: Index Factor
IndexFactor.definition: Index rate applied to the amount paid to adjust it for instance to inflation.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Percentage to be added to or deducted from the index rate to calculate the effective rate.

PortfolioBenchmark.name: Portfolio Benchmark
PortfolioBenchmark.definition: Portfolio benchmark which uses an index for decomposition,

VariableInterest.name: Variable Interest
VariableInterest.definition: Variable interest which uises the index.
